explanation: The top-level corpus contains eight qualifying demand records with demand_score >= 3, including n06-r06. Job 1's select_demand would select all eight, but normalize filters against an allowed_record_ids list that omits n06-r06 and includes n06-r09 instead. The downstream handoff consequently contains only seven needs/evidence_sources and Job 2's observed output can only process those seven records. This violates the requirement to select all qualifying records and retain allowed record identities without silently omitting stipulated records.
cited_evidence: top_level_input.corpus includes n06-r06 with demand_score 5 and need 'compare selected and complete runtime evidence'.

normalize source has allowed_record_ids ['n06-r01','n06-r02','n06-r03','n06-r04','n06-r05','n06-r09','n06-r07','n06-r08'], omitting n06-r06.
